title: Threshadon
wikitext:
[[image:threshadon.png|thumb|]]

A large, long-necked aquatic dinosaur that can only [[Swim|swim]].  Found in [[Darkshore]], the [[Wailing Caverns]], [[Loch Modan]], and more.  There is apparently a threshadon named Nessy hiding in the underwater section of the [[Deeprun Tram]].
